summary.short: Draft revision for public comment of the Guangzhou AI development promotion regulation. It applies within Guangzhou's administrative area, promotes AI infrastructure, data, procurement, funding and talent support, prohibits listed AI conduct, and imposes civil liability for resulting harm. The effective date is blank.
summary.long: This draft revision of the Guangzhou AI development promotion regulation applies to AI factor support, application, industrial development and security activities within Guangzhou's administrative area. It establishes a municipal AI leading group and expert committee, and tasks development, science, industry, data and other departments with computing infrastructure, a city-wide computing coordination platform, open and authorised public data resources, high-quality datasets, testbeds and application scenario opening. Government procurement of listed AI products and services is encouraged, and funding, land, startup investment, talent and industrial park support are provided. Article 18 sets inclusive, tiered supervision for new AI technologies and products. Article 19 prohibits AI research and application activities that lack measures against discriminatory outcomes, that fail to implement content review, labelling or algorithm review and cause harmful AI-generated false information, that use algorithms for price discrimination or consumer fraud, or that lack safety intervention and accountability mechanisms in autonomous driving and intelligent medical systems causing harm. Other penalties are left to the cited laws and regulations, and harm may give rise to civil liability. Article 21 leaves the effective date blank..
